svg.title: AI-driven development and certifications
svg.desc: A swirling luminance-shaded ASCII core labelled Claude Code plus MCP, orbited in 3D by the loop: spec, plan, code, test, review, ship. Notes: AI-driven development with Claude Code; MCP connects agents to the codebase, tools and data; GitHub Copilot in the editor; local RAG with LangChain, Ollama and ChromaDB; Tesseract OCR services at Humana. Certifications as plain text: Anthropic Claude Code in Action, Introduction to Model Context Protocol and Claude 101 (Aug 2026); Microsoft AZ-204 Azure Developer Associate, AI-900 Azure AI Fundamentals, AZ-900 Azure Fundamentals.

g.text: spec → ship · human in the loop
